verdict.rationale: Granola's own API docs name this use case: extracting action items from notes and automatically creating tasks in Linear, Jira, or Todoist. A Zapier integration and an MCP server also let automations and agents act on notes after a meeting. However, the user or a developer must build the pipeline; there is no native tracker integration or webhook trigger, and one community user reports action items slipping through and building their own tool. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integration, documented webhooks or event triggers for new meetings, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), and hands-on corroboration that the tracker flow works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
